decisions.statement: Every landing records its commit against one writer.
That writer is a name and an address.
A path sits under a folder named for the slug.
A page path ends in the page type.
A jsonl path ends in the property that has the rows.
A file kept beside a page takes the page path with the ending swapped.
A path that is no page file gives back nothing.
Every slug of one page type is asked of the pages in one read.
A slug the pages placed no file for is refused rather than passed over.
A read naming no slug leaves the pages unasked.
The export a page body declares is named for the slug in lower camel case.
The type a page body satisfies is the page type slug in upper camel case.
The import a page body opens with names the page type file from the root.
A page body ends with a newline.
A jsonl body is the lines joined by newlines with a newline after the last.
A jsonl body with no line is empty rather than one newline.
A blank line in a jsonl body is dropped on the way back out.
A line that is no JSON reads back as empty text for every key.
A line goes in ahead of the first line marked later than it.
A key told nothing is left out of a jsonl line rather than written as null.
Four attempts are made at the most.
Only an attempt after the first waits.
A refusal names how many attempts were spent.
A caller may hand in the calls that reach the store.
A caller may hand in the call that waits between attempts.
Nothing here knows the properties any one page type carries.

definition: the shared half of landing a page and the jsonl rows beside it from the watcher
